matchReminder.title: Match in {offset}
matchReminder.bodyCleared: The time set for {previous} (Paris time) has been removed: a new time will be announced. {pairing} · {tournament}, {round}.
matchReminder.bodyWithdrawn: The tournament has been updated and you no longer play this match: the time set for {previous} (Paris time) no longer applies to you. {pairing} · {tournament}, {round}.
matchReminder.checkIn: Check-in on Discord {minutes} min before the match: {invite}

matchScheduled.bodyCleared: The time set for {previous} (Paris time) has been removed. {pairing} · {tournament}, {round}.

scoreToConfirm.title: Score to confirm
scoreToConfirm.body: {opponent} entered the score of your match ({tournament}). Confirm it, or dispute it: with no answer, it will be confirmed automatically.
scoreToConfirm.bodyPaused: {opponent} entered the score of your match ({tournament}). Confirm it, or dispute it: automatic confirmation is paused by a referee, and a referee will decide if there is no answer.

scoreAutoValidated.title: Score confirmed automatically
scoreAutoValidated.body: The score entered for your match ({tournament}) was confirmed automatically: no one confirmed or disputed it before the deadline.

tournamentStart.title: The tournament is starting
tournamentStart.body: {tournament} has started. Find your first match on the tournament page.

teamJoinRequest.title: Join request
teamJoinRequest.body: A player is asking to join {team}. Answer from the team's page.

contentReport.title: A report concerns you
contentReport.body: Report ({category}): no decision has been made. Read it and appeal it if it's unfounded.

logo.HIDDEN: The logo of {team} has been hidden.
logo.REMOVED: The logo of {team} has been deleted.
logo.RESTORED: The logo of {team} has been restored.

next.writeUs: Write to the association if you hold the rights to it.

suspension.suspended: Your account has been suspended. The decision, its grounds and how to appeal it are shown at your next login attempt.
suspension.lifted: Your account's suspension has been lifted: you can log in again.

privacyChange.title: Your data: what's changing
privacyChange.body: {first}. The details are waiting for you on your next visit.
privacyChange.bodyMore: {first} (and {others, plural, one {# other} other {# others}}). The details are waiting for you on your next visit.

refereeAlert.title: Referee needed
refereeAlert.score_conflict: Conflicting scores are waiting for a referee.
refereeAlert.score_report_stalled: A disputed score has been waiting too long for a referee: score entry stays locked for both opponents, a referee needs to decide.
refereeAlert.other: An alert is waiting for a referee.
refereeAlert.score_conflictMatch: Conflicting scores · {tournament}, {round}: a referee is needed.
refereeAlert.score_report_stalledMatch: Dispute without a referee for too long · {tournament}, {round}: entry locked, a referee needs to decide.

selfResolved.title: Dispute settled by a player of the match
selfResolved.body: A staff member who plays in this match settled its dispute · {tournament}, {round}: {outcome}.

selfCorrected.title: Result corrected by a player of the match
selfCorrected.body: A staff member who plays in this match corrected its result · {tournament}, {round}: {outcome}.

selfForfeit.title: Withdrawal imposed by a player of the match
selfForfeit.body: A staff member who plays in this match imposed their opponent's withdrawal · {tournament}, {round}: {outcome}.

selfPaused.title: Confirmation paused by a player of the match
selfPaused.body: A staff member who plays in this match paused its automatic confirmation · {tournament}, {round}.

staffReport.bodyReport: A report is waiting for moderation.
staffReport.bodyContest: A moderation decision is being appealed.
staffReport.bodySaturated: The next reports reach the panel without an alert.

refereeDigest.title: Refereeing schedule: {count, plural, one {# upcoming match} other {# upcoming matches}}

castReleased.title: Cast removed
castReleased.body: Your caster registration has been removed: {reason}. {pairing} · {tournament}, {round}.

reason.REPLACED: you no longer met the casting requirements, another caster took your place
reason.INELIGIBLE: you no longer meet the casting requirements
reason.JOINED_TEAM: your team now plays this match
